summary: The PR correctly implements the required sign and verify functions for time-bounded download URLs, adhering to the specified message format and constant-time comparison requirements.
key_findings: sign_path_token correctly generates HMAC-SHA256 over the formatted path:expires_at string.
verify_path_token correctly checks expiration and uses hmac.compare_digest for constant-time verification.
Existing legacy function expiry_remaining remains unchanged and passing.
